name: Sarah Ellis
source: Sarah is cool under pressure, but with an impatient streak that garnered her the reputation of somebody you wouldn’t want to cross. She is highly observant and calculating. She loves beer, animals and honestly thinks she can never have too many pink fluffy slippers.
